 Your Guide to the 9 Massachusetts Ballot Questions
 On Nov. 3, Massachusetts voters will decide on nine statewide ballot questions covering everything from government transparency and public defenders’ unionization to election rules, housing, marijuana, and gun laws. The Crimson breaks down what each proposal would do, the arguments for and against it, and what your vote could mean.
